title: [tool.flasgo]
description: Defaults for the flasgo command, read from pyproject.toml in the current directory. Command-line options override them. See https://flasgo.dev

target.description: App used by flasgo run, routes, openapi, and check when no target is passed: a Python file, package directory, or import string such as package.module:app.

app.description: Application variable name when loading from a Python file, like --app. An explicit :attribute in target takes precedence.

reload.description: Enable or disable automatic reload, like --reload / --no-reload. When unset, the app's DEBUG setting decides.

reload_dirs.description: Directories to watch for reload in addition to the target's own directory. --reload-dir replaces this list.

config.description: Alembic .ini file, like --config; used only when it exists. A path named pyproject.toml is treated like pyproject.

pyproject.description: pyproject.toml whose [tool.alembic] table configures Alembic, like --pyproject; used only when it has that table.

directory.description: Migration script directory for flasgo db init, like --directory.

template.description: Alembic environment template for flasgo db init, like --template.
